title: El Sobre de Álamos, MEXI TV
comment: sobre-alamos (MEXITV): despacho de una hacienda colonial en Álamos, Sonora, lectura de testamento. Caras comunes, no famosas; los cuatro se distinguen a simple vista.

chars.LIC_BARRAGAN: Mexican notary, 60 years old, thin, light skin, white hair neatly combed, round tortoiseshell glasses, a charcoal-grey three-piece suit, a dark-green tie, black shoes, his hands empty.
chars.FERNANDO_ROBLES: Mexican man from Sonora, 45 years old, fair skin, short light-brown hair, a trimmed beard, a black suit jacket over a white open-collar shirt, a gold watch, dark trousers, his hands empty.
chars.LORENA_ROBLES: Mexican woman from Sonora, 42 years old, fair skin, shoulder-length straight blonde-highlighted hair, big sunglasses pushed on her head, a black fitted mourning dress, a pearl necklace, black heels, her hands empty.
chars.NICANOR_DURAN: Mexican ranch foreman from Sonora, 62 years old, dark sun-tanned skin, deep wrinkles, short grey hair, a grey mustache, a clean faded denim shirt buttoned to the neck, a brown leather belt, dusty jeans, worn brown boots, holding a beige straw cowboy hat against his chest.

locs.LOC_DESPACHOALAMOS: Study of an old colonial hacienda in Álamos, Sonora, in the afternoon: thick white walls, a tall wooden door, a long dark wooden table with high-backed leather chairs, one empty leather armchair at the end, bookshelves, a window with iron bars and sunlight, no readable text, no signs, no logos, no people.
